context_notes: Two findings dominate. FIRST, the defect this project keeps hitting reached eight occurrences: a count true of the part someone examined and false of the whole. Latest instances -- REQUIREMENTS.md's own coverage table summed to 81 against its declared 93, and STATE.md's prose described Phase 15 for four days while its own frontmatter directly above said 16 phases complete. Two statements of one fact with no check between them. The fix that works is putting the re-derivation COMMAND next to the number, which both documents now do. SECOND, Phase 20's verification found a SURVIVING MUTANT: erasing a refusal message's destination interpolation left the entire suite green, because five proofs asserted the box name and the phrase 'cannot compute' and none asserted where the amount would have gone -- the only actionable part of the message. That class is unswept across the other five dialects carrying refusal strings. Also corrected: AGENTS.md's own '&& false' mutation recipe does not work inside an if statement under allowUnreachableCode: false, so any pre-2026-08-16 plan specifying one will silently fail to run rather than fail to pass.
